title: Senior Account Executive Public Sector (m/w/d)

Identify, prioritize, and develop target customers, market opportunities, and strategic accounts while building a long-term sales pipeline. Analyze market, technology, and regulatory trends and derive targeted sales initiatives in collaboration with marketing, partners, and internal experts. Strategic Account & Client Management Build and expand strategic client relationships and develop long-term partnerships. Establish trusted relationships with stakeholders across business, IT, procurement, and executive levels while understanding decision-making structures. Develop and execute account plans and drive cross-sell, upsell, and growth opportunities by positioning our service and solution portfolio. Network Development Build and maintain a strong network of public sector stakeholders, decision-makers, partners, and industry influencers. Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking forums to strengthen market presence and expand market access. Manage pipeline, forecasting, and closing activities, including risk, stakeholder, and decision-management processes. Develop winning bid, positioning, and partnering strategies in collaboration with Bid Management, Solution Experts, and external partners. Im Erstgespräch und im Workshop fragst du so lange nach, bis klar ist, wo beim Kunden Zeit und Geld liegen bleiben. Du zeigst die Lösung. In der Demo sieht der Kunde seinen eigenen Rechnungseingang, seine Personalakte oder seinen Vertragsprozess – nicht eine Standardpräsentation. Du entwirfst das Lösungskonzept: welche Bausteine aus Scan, DocuWare, Workflow, Schnittstellen und E-Signatur zusammenpassen und was sie bringen. Du kalkulierst den Aufwand, schreibst das Angebot gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb und vertrittst es vor Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Fachabteilung. Du übergibst gewonnene Projekte sauber dokumentiert an unser Team Technischer Service & Implementierung und bleibst für den Kunden ansprechbar. Du baust Wiederverwendbares auf: Demo-Umgebungen, Lösungsvorlagen und Referenzszenarien für unsere Zielbranchen. Worauf du dich einstellst Wir verkaufen kein Standardprodukt. Jeder Kunde hat andere Systeme, andere Abläufe und andere Vorgaben – du baust daraus eine Lösung, die trägt. Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Buchhaltung. Die eine will Zahlen, die andere Architektur, die dritte einen Alltag, der funktioniert. Du stehst zwischen Vertrieb und Technik. Du versprichst nur, was unser Implementierungsteam liefern kann. Du arbeitest an mehreren Kunden gleichzeitig und hältst Fristen für Angebote und Ausschreibungen. Du bist bei Kunden vor Ort und online unterwegs. Wen wir suchen Du hast Erfahrung in Presales, Consulting, Business Analyse oder der Einführung von Unternehmenssoftware. Du denkst in Prozessen. Du verstehst, wie ein Rechnungseingang, eine Freigabe oder eine Aktenführung abläuft, und siehst, wo es hakt. Du erklärst Technik so, dass eine Geschäftsführung entscheidet und eine IT-Leitung zustimmt. Du bist technisch fit: Schnittstellen, Cloud und On-Premises, Berechtigungen und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut. Programmieren musst du nicht. Du schreibst Konzepte und Angebote, die man ohne Rückfrage versteht. Du arbeitest selbstständig, verbindlich und gern im Team mit Vertrieb und Technik. Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch, weil Workshops, Konzepte und Angebote auf Deutsch laufen. At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Many management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds, yet they struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren’t built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so our clients can launch and run ETFs at scale, helping broaden the access to the market beyond a small group of dominant, US-based providers.

𝘕𝘢𝘳𝘰𝘐𝘘 𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘤𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘴𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘎𝘋𝘗 𝘰𝘧 𝘌𝘶𝘳𝘰𝘱𝘦.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

You will own end-to-end responsibility for the ETFs we run: smooth product launches, day-to-day execution and oversight, as well as continuous platform evolution in collaboration with our product team. This is a strongly hands-on role combining investment expertise, market microstructure understanding, operational excellence and cross-functional execution.

You will gain 𝘥𝘦𝘦𝘱 𝘦𝘹𝘱𝘰𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘰 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘧𝘶𝘭𝘭 𝘌𝘛𝘍 𝘷𝘢𝘭𝘶𝘦 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘪𝘯, from investment implementation and market mechanics to operational and technology execution. You will have the opportunity to gradually expand your scope into platform building, process scaling, new strategic projects and service development.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂’𝗹𝗹 𝗗𝗼

Capital Markets

  • Own end-to-end ETF delivery across capital markets, portfolio replication and platform operations

  • Implement and continuously improve replication models; execute index rebalances and support advisory mandates

  • Own ETF quality monitoring (tracking error/difference, liquidity/spreads, premiums/discounts, order books), run root-cause analyses and implement corrective actions

  • Manage creation/redemptions and associated cash flows; oversee daily ETF operations from a portfolio perspective

  • Support larger secondary market transactions, produce/interpret trade reporting and support ETF launches

Portfolio Management

  • Take investment ownership for assigned ETFs, actively optimizing portfolio construction, risk and execution to enhance tracking and liquidity

  • Execute portfolio replication and rebalancing

  • Run daily validation and reconciliation of key data outputs (pricing, holdings and reference data)

Clients and Ecosystem

  • Join client demos and workshops as our capital markets expert

  • Represent NaroIQ at industry events, roundtables and conferences together with our Growth team

  • Support our Growth and Clients teams on client-specific questions

Working with Product

  • Raise requirements from daily operations and give business sign-off on what Product delivers

  • Use and stress-test the AI-driven workflows we build for ETF operations, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

(𝘠𝘰𝘶 𝘥𝘰𝘯’𝘵 𝘯𝘦𝘦𝘥 𝘵𝘰 𝘬𝘯𝘰𝘸 𝘪𝘵 𝘢𝘭𝘭 – 𝘣𝘶𝘵 𝘺𝘰𝘶 𝘴𝘩𝘰𝘶𝘭𝘥 𝘣𝘦 𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘥𝘺 𝘵𝘰 𝘥𝘪𝘷𝘦 𝘪𝘯, 𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘯 𝘧𝘢𝘴𝘵 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘵𝘢𝘬𝘦 𝘪𝘯𝘪𝘵𝘪𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘷𝘦)

  • Experience in ETF operations, capital markets, trading, portfolio management, or fund operations

  • Strong understanding of ETF primary/secondary market mechanics

  • Hands-on experience running a portfolio management system, ideally to the point of owning its setup, data and daily use

  • Comfort with operational excellence: high ownership, detail orientation and reliability in a mission-critical operating environment

  • Experience working at the intersection of finance and tech

  • Analytical strength and ability to translate domain needs into clear product requirements

  • You use AI tools in your daily work and would rather automate a process than run it by hand

  • Comfortable being the external face of the function: with market makers, at industry events and in client demos

  • Fluent in English and German

  • CAIA/CFA is a plus

𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗡𝗮𝗿𝗼𝗜𝗤

We’re building something ambitious – and we believe the only way to do that is with a team that’s 𝘭𝘰𝘸-𝘦𝘨𝘰, 𝘩𝘪𝘨𝘩-𝘪𝘮𝘱𝘢𝘤𝘵 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘨𝘦𝘯𝘶𝘪𝘯𝘦𝘭𝘺 𝘦𝘹𝘤𝘪𝘵𝘦𝘥 about what they’re doing.

Here’s what we care about:

🔑 𝗛𝗶𝗴𝗵 𝗢𝘄𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 We trust you to take full responsibility for your work. That means freedom – and also being the person others rely on when things get real.

🚫 𝗡𝗼 𝗕𝘂𝗹𝗹𝘀𝗵𝗶𝘁, 𝗡𝗼 𝗘𝗴𝗼 We’re too small for politics, posturing, or competing agendas. We care about doing the right thing, not being right.

🧘‍♂️ 𝗙𝗹𝗲𝘅𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 Exceptional work doesn’t require relocation or fixed office hours. Have dinner with your family. Get that dog. Move to the Alps. We’re remote-friendly and trust people to manage their own time.

🧳 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲𝘀 𝗪𝗲 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗛𝗼𝘂𝘀𝗲 We don’t believe in constant travel, but we do make time for real-life moments – like quarterly offsites or in-person team sessions – to solve stuff together or just hang out.

🦸🏻‍♀️ 𝗛𝗶𝗿𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗦𝗽𝗶𝗸𝗲𝘀 We don’t expect you to be good at everything. We care about your superpower. We’re building a team of nerds who are world-class in wildly different areas.

💡 𝗖𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 – 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗙𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗼𝘄𝘀 𝗧𝗵𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗴𝗵 Customers are basically the only reason we exist. And we don’t build tech for tech’s sake. But the best user experiences usually rely on thoughtful, powerful engineering – so we invest in both, deeply.

🛠 𝗗𝗲𝗳𝗮𝘂𝗹𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗥𝗲𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗸 We don’t accept “that’s just how it is.” We dig deep, think from scratch and always believe there’s a better way.

💅🏼 𝗚𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿𝘀𝗲𝗹𝗳 𝗮 𝗟𝗶𝘁𝘁𝗹𝗲 𝗧𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁 We use hrmony, so you can spend up to €50/month on the little things that bring you joy – Urban Sports, DAZN, Mediamarkt, Thalia, whatever suits you.

Du bringst ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Software und webbasierte Anwendungen mit. Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch. title: After Sales Manager (m/w/d)
description: WaschMal ist ein moderner Dienstleister für professionelle Wäschereilösungen und Textilmanagement. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, ihre Berufsbekleidung und betrieblichen Textilien effizient, hygienisch und wirtschaftlich zu verwalten. Unser Leistungsspektrum umfasst die Bereitstellung, Pflege, Reinigung, Reparatur und den Austausch von Berufsbekleidung sowie die individuelle Betreuung unserer Kunden durch ein leistungsstarkes Netzwerk aus Wäschereien, Herstellern und Servicepartnern. Durch intelligente Servicekonzepte helfen wir unseren Kunden, Prozesse zu vereinfachen, Kosten zu reduzieren und höchste Qualitäts- und Hygienestandards sicherzustellen. Dabei stehen Kundennähe, Zuverlässigkeit und nachhaltige Partnerschaften im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns. Als stark wachsendes Unternehmen setzen wir auf innovative Lösungen, persönliche Betreuung und den konsequenten Ausbau unseres Partnernetzwerks. Unser Ziel ist es, für unsere Kunden der bevorzugte Ansprechpartner für moderne Wäschereidienstleistungen und professionelles Textilmanagement zu sein. Aufgaben Vertragsimplementierung: Du übernimmst nach Vertragsabschluss die zentrale Verantwortung für die Implementierung neuer Kundenprojekte und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem Vertrieb zusammen. Projektmanagement: Du koordinierst alle notwendigen Schritte und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte strukturiert und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden. Partnerkoordination: Du organisierst und koordinierst unsere externen Waschpartner und stellst sicher, dass alle benötigten Dienstleistungen und Produkte verfügbar sind Projektverfolgung: Du behältst den Überblick über zahlreiche parallel laufende Projekte, erkennst Handlungsbedarf und sorgst für eine konsequente Nachverfolgung. Reklamationsmanagement: Du kümmerst dich eigenständig um Reklamationen beim Onboarding, koordinierst Lösungen und führst proaktiv Feedbackgespräche, um Probleme frühzeitig zu erkennen. CRM-Dokumentation: Du dokumentierst relevante Informationen, Gesprächsinhalte und Projektfortschritte in unserem CRM-System und stellst eine zuverlässige Nachverfolgung sicher. Qualifikation Idealerweise hast du eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein Studium oder bereits erste Berufserfahrung im After Sales, Projektmanagement oder Vertrieb. Auch Quereinsteiger*innen sind willkommen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich. Du besitzt Durchsetzungsvermögen und scheust dich nicht davor, Dinge aktiv anzustoßen und konsequent nachzuverfolgen. Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent und trittst gegenüber Kunden und Geschäftspartnern souverän auf. Du hast Organisationstalent und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Projekten den Überblick. Du denkst lösungsorientiert und hast Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Der sichere Umgang mit MS Office ist für dich selbstverständlich. Du bringst die Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Vor-Ort-Terminen bei Kunden oder Partnern mit. Benefits Eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle in einem wachsenden Unternehmen. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum hybriden Arbeiten. Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. title: HYROX Nutrition Activation Manager (m/f/d)
description: HYROX is a global sports event series that combines running and functional fitness training in a unique race format. Founded in Germany in 2017, HYROX has evolved into a worldwide fitness movement with events across five continents, attracting millions of athletes every season. We are building the premier global fitness racing brand, empowering people of all backgrounds to train and compete together. As HYROX Nutrition Activation Manager (m/f/d), you will be the driving force behind bringing our sports nutrition category to life directly on the global race floor! You will lead the charge in planning and executing high-energy event activations, immersive sampling setups, and live consumer touchpoints that fuel our athletes and captivate thousands of spectators worldwide. If you thrive in fast-paced event environments, love building unforgettable brand experiences, and want to own our global field activation strategy, this is your arena! YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Event Activation & On-Site Execution: Plan, direct, and execute all HYROX Nutrition category activations, store setups, and sampling stations across key regional markets, prioritizing European events as the foundation for broader international expansion. Manage end-to-end event logistics for the nutrition brand, including inventory, booth infrastructure, branding assets, and supplier coordination. Lead on-site staff during event weekends to ensure high-energy execution, perfect brand presence, and excellent customer engagement. Sampling & Engagement Strategy: Develop and optimize targeted sampling strategies to maximize product trial, consumer education, and conversion among athletes and spectators. Create interactive, high-impact activation concepts that drive product sales, social media buzz, and direct-to-consumer (D2C) lead generation during events. Coordinate on-site influencer and ambassador activations in close alignment with the HYROX Nutrition Marketing Manager and wider marketing team. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination: Serve as the main point of contact on-site for external brand partners and sponsors participating in HYROX Nutrition event activations. Work in close cross-functional collaboration with internal departments (Direct Sales, Operations, Partnerships) to ensure smooth event delivery. Coordinate with venue teams and local suppliers to meet safety, layout, and operational requirements. Budget & Process Management : Manage, track, and optimize the allocated activation budget for all event-related nutrition initiatives. Streamline event preparation workflows, tools, and timelines using project management platforms (e.g., Monday.com). Evaluate post-event performance through KPI tracking (sampling volume, sales conversion, lead capture) to continuously refine future event setups. YOUR PROFILE Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in event marketing, experiential marketing, or field activation, ideally within Sports Nutrition, FMCG, Fitness, or Lifestyle brands. Event & Onsite Expertise: Strong track record in planning and executing large-scale live event activations, pop-ups, or trade show setups from concept to tear-down. Hands-On Leadership: Energetic personality with proven experience leading on-site teams, brand ambassadors, and event personnel in high-tempo event environments. Logistics & Organization: Process-driven with strong operational skills; experienced in managing project workflows (e.g., Monday.com) and managing event budgets. Flexibility & Travel: High flexibility and readiness to travel frequently for weekend event execution across key markets. Languages: Business-fluent English skills (written and spoken) are required; German or additional languages are a plus. WHAT WE OFFER The opportunity to take on responsibility in a fast-growing, international company with a strong sports DNA. Flat hierarchies, quick decision-making processes, and plenty of room for your ideas. A motivated, international team with a genuine passion for sports and events. A healthy work-life balance thanks to flexible, trust-based working hours. A modern office in a top location – right in Hamburg Altona with excellent transport connections. 28 vacation days to recharge and reset. A Wellpass membership and discounted lunch options in-house. Your Deutschlandticket is fully covered by us – nationwide mobility, 100% on us. Employee discounts in our HYROX stores. INTERESTED? Then we look forward to receiving your application. Simply upload your CV as a PDF (no photo required) and answer the questions in the application form. Your contact person is Lotte (HYROX People). We are committed to creating an inclusive and respectful work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic. description: Über uns Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken. Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Your Mission with us Do you want to learn how to run successful campaigns with some of Europe's most exciting influencers and build lasting partnerships? We are looking for an intern for at least six months in Influencer & Content Creator Marketing. You will support our creator marketing team in bringing our vision of a healthier life through innovative probiotics to more people. Working alongside a dynamic and motivated team, you will help grow our brand Kijimea in the Italian and Spanish market through authentic influencer collaborations across all different creator levels and creative social media campaigns. Your Tasks You support the identification and outreach of suitable influencers and content creators, with a focus on the Italian and Spanish market. You stay in close contact with influencers and content creators, coordinate their content, and maintain long-term relationships. You help prepare and conduct negotiations and draft cooperation agreements. You contribute creative campaign ideas, help implement them with the team, and analyze performance (reach, engagement, ROI). You follow current social media trends and bring your own ideas into future projects. Your Profile You are studying business administration, economics, marketing, or a comparable field (e.g., life sciences or communication science) with excellent academic performance. You can support our team as an intern for at least six months onsite in our office in Gräfelfing (near Munich). You have an affinity for social media and enthusiasm for influencer marketing. Ideally, you already have initial experience in marketing or with influencers/creators - knowledge of the Italian and Spanish market (media and brand landscape, influencers, consumer behavior) is a strong advantage. You work in a structured, data-driven way and with great attention to detail You communicate confidently with external partners and thrive in a fast-paced and analytical environment You speak Italian and English fluently (C1 or higher) and Spanish at conversational (B1-B2) level. German and other European languages is an advantage Our Promise We offer you a varied, demanding job with exciting tasks and wide scope for shaping your role! With us, you will find short decision-making paths, responsibility from day one, and the freedom to try new approaches. You will join a highly motivated team and a real sense of purpose: with your personal contribution, help give millions of people a new lease on life. Do you have any questions? Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten. Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen. Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display. Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern. Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus. So geht es für dich weiter: Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Videointerview mit deiner zukünftigen Führungskraft: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen. Persönliches Kennenlernen : Du triffst das Team und erhältst praktische Einblicke in die Arbeit eines Relationship Managers. Über uns Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit. Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. title: Product Designer (m/f/x)
description: UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group. We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy. You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short. What you will do: Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them. Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first. Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path. Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work. Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one. Scope your own features, break them into pieces, be roughly right about how long they will take, and flag delays early with a plan B rather than a warning. Contribute to our design system, as everyone on our team does: propose and build components, not only use them. Share your work cross-functionally, take feedback, and iterate; notice improvements inside your area and act on them, instead of waiting to be asked. Here is a good summary of what we are looking for: Experience delivering product design work end-to-end inside a cross-functional team. Solid interaction (IxD) and visual/UI design skills, with the ability to make complex data and workflows understandable. Strong Figma skills, and a working understanding of how a design system is actually built: how a component is structured, how it behaves, and the rules it has to respect. You will be a contributor to ours, not only a user of it. Experience using research and product evidence to make design decisions: usability tests, customer conversations, support tickets, product data. We are not looking for one particular method. Comfortable telling the difference between what we know and what we are assuming, and willing to say which is which. Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when the picture is still incomplete, and to adjust when what you learn changes the direction. Able to scope your own work and communicate honestly about time, collaborative, feedback-driven, and proactive about the problems you can see. Fluent in English and based in Berlin with hybrid work capability. Bonus points if you bring: Experience designing geospatial, enterprise, or data-heavy B2B products. Background in UX research, data visualization, or complex workflow design. Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design. Experience with interactive prototyping. Awareness of current AI tools and emerging opportunities in UX processes, with an understanding of how AI can enhance user outcomes without adding unnecessary complexity. Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice: Let’s disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective Let’s stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year Let’s win as a team: We’re an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment Let’s be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, an educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few Let’s enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year Let’s think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English. Our culture is one of belonging, where everyone feels welcome and where differences are celebrated. We seek to recruit the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background and/or belief—and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We also value more than the skills and experiences outlined in this job description. Even if you think you only fill 60% of the requirements for this role - we would still like to consider your application. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group.

We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy.
You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short.

What you will do:

  • Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them.

  • Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first.

  • Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path.

  • Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work.

  • Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one.

  • Scope your own features, break them into pieces, be roughly right about how long they will take, and flag delays early with a plan B rather than a warning.

  • Contribute to our design system, as everyone on our team does: propose and build components, not only use them.

  • Share your work cross-functionally, take feedback, and iterate; notice improvements inside your area and act on them, instead of waiting to be asked.


Here is a good summary of what we are looking for:

  • Experience delivering product design work end-to-end inside a cross-functional team.

  • Solid interaction (IxD) and visual/UI design skills, with the ability to make complex data and workflows understandable.

  • Strong Figma skills, and a working understanding of how a design system is actually built: how a component is structured, how it behaves, and the rules it has to respect. You will be a contributor to ours, not only a user of it.

  • Experience using research and product evidence to make design decisions: usability tests, customer conversations, support tickets, product data. We are not looking for one particular method.

  • Comfortable telling the difference between what we know and what we are assuming, and willing to say which is which.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when the picture is still incomplete, and to adjust when what you learn changes the direction.

  • Able to scope your own work and communicate honestly about time, collaborative, feedback-driven, and proactive about the problems you can see.

  • Fluent in English and based in Berlin with hybrid work capability.

Bonus points if you bring:

  • Experience designing geospatial, enterprise, or data-heavy B2B products.

  • Background in UX research, data visualization, or complex workflow design.

  • Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design.

  • Experience with interactive prototyping.

  • Awareness of current AI tools and emerging opportunities in UX processes, with an understanding of how AI can enhance user outcomes without adding unnecessary complexity.

Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice:

  • Let’s disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective

  • Let’s stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year

  • Let’s win as a team: We’re an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment

  • Let’s be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, an educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few

  • Let’s enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year

  • Let’s think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership

Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English.

Our culture is one of belonging, where everyone feels welcome and where differences are celebrated. We seek to recruit the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background and/or belief—and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We also value more than the skills and experiences outlined in this job description. Even if you think you only fill 60% of the requirements for this role - we would still like to consider your application.

Location: Stuttgart

  • Knowledge of SAP QM and/or SD is an advantage
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA is desirable
  • ABAP development experience is a plus, but not essential
  • Knowledge of SAP DMS and Workflow would be beneficial
  • Strong understanding of both business processes and SAP solutions
  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders and translating business requirements into technical solutions
  • Strong communication and consulting skills
  • Fluent German (C1+) and business-fluent English
  • A structured, proactive and solution-oriented approach
  • Comfortable taking ownership of projects and working collaboratively with different teams

What is Offered

  • Permanent position within an established international organisation
  • Hybrid working model with regular on-site collaboration
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Opportunities for professional development and further training
  • Attractive employee benefits
  • Supportive and collaborative working environment
  • Opportunity to contribute to major SAP transformation and digitalisation initiatives

title: Werkstudent (w/m/d) im KI Startup mit Impact | Finance & Accounting
description: Gestalte die Zukunft der öffentlichen Verwaltung mit uns! Ayunis (ehem. Locaboo) ist ein führendes GovTech-Startup aus München mit über 900 Kunden (Städte, Gemeinden und Kommunen) in der DACH-Region. Aber öffentlicher Sektor? Ist das nicht super-bürokratisch? Das dachten wir zu Beginn auch. Aber der öffentliche Bereich ist stark im Wandel und du wirst schnell merken, wie unglaublich offen und motiviert die Menschen in der Verwaltung sind. Sie sind einfach nur mega happy, dass sich bei der Digitalisierung endlich etwas tut. Deine Rolle Als Werkstudent im Bereich Finance & Accounting arbeitest du eng mit unserem CEO und unserer externen Steuerberatung zusammen und erhältst wertvolle Einblicke in die finanzielle Steuerung eines schnell wachsenden KI-Startups. Dabei geht es um weit mehr als Buchhaltung: Du unterstützt uns beim Cashflow-Management, der Finanzplanung und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Businesspläne . Du lernst, wie ein SaaS-Unternehmen wirtschaftlich gesteuert wird und wie finanzielle Entscheidungen unser Wachstum beeinflussen. Für dich heißt das: echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins statt Zuarbeit auf Zuruf. Aufgaben Du unterstützt uns bei der vorbereitenden Buchhaltung und im Accounting , prüfst Rechnungen, behältst offene Posten im Blick und arbeitest eng mit unserer externen Steuerberatung zusammen. Du wirkst aktiv an unserem Cashflow-Management und der Liquiditätsplanung mit, analysierst Zahlungsströme und hilfst dabei, unsere finanzielle Entwicklung im Blick zu behalten. Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Finanzplanung und Businesspläne und modellierst gemeinsam mit uns unterschiedliche Wachstums- und Finanzierungsszenarien. Du erstellst Finanzreportings und KPI-Auswertungen und hilfst uns, wichtige SaaS-Kennzahlen wie ARR, MRR, Burn Rate und Runway zu analysieren. Du entwickelst unsere internen Finance-Prozesse und Automatisierungen weiter und hast die Freiheit, neue Tools und eigene Ideen einzubringen – insbesondere auch beim Einsatz von KI im Finanzbereich. Qualifikation Du bist mindestens für die nächsten 6–12 Monate immatrikulierte Bachelor- oder Masterstudent , idealerweise in BWL, Finance, Accounting, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und möchtest verstehen, wie ein wachsendes Technologieunternehmen finanziell gesteuert wird. Du bist auffassungsstark, proaktiv und „machst“ Dinge, wo andere erstmal reden . Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und sorgfältig und gehst verantwortungsbewusst mit vertraulichen Informationen um. Du hast gute Kenntnisse in Excel oder Google Sheets und Spaß daran, mit Zahlen, Analysen und Finanzmodellen zu arbeiten. Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und hast Englischkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau. Plus-Punkt: Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Finance-, Accounting- oder Controlling-Bereich durch Praktika oder Werkstudierendentätigkeiten gesammelt. Plus-Punkt: Du hast bereits mit DATEV, Agicap oder vergleichbaren Finance- und Accounting-Tools gearbeitet. Plus-Punkt: Du hast eine hohe technische Affinität und bereits Erfahrungen mit KI-Tools oder der Automatisierung von Prozessen gesammelt. Benefits 18 €/h bei 15–20 Stunden pro Woche Du hast die Möglichkeit, in einem schnell wachsenden Startup von Beginn an dabei zu sein und dieses aktiv mitzugestalten Nach dem Abschluss deines Studiums hast du die Chance, in Vollzeit bei uns übernommen zu werden Lockere Arbeitsatmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien Flexible Arbeitszeiten & hybrides Arbeiten sowie Workation im EU-Ausland Neues Office in München mit voll ausgestatteter Küche, gemütlicher Lounge-Ecke und einem 50 Meter langen Outdoor-Pool (!) Neueste technische Ausstattung – auch zur privaten Nutzung (z. B. MacBook) Regelmäßige Team-Events & Off-Sites (z. B. Wiesn & Isarfloßfahrt) Du erfüllst nicht alle Kriterien? No worries – wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Motivation & Ownership sind für uns wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: About Rain for Rent International Rain for Rent International provides innovative tank systems for liquid management applications. Your role We are looking for a hands-on Branch Support Manager ( m/f/d ) to help our teams across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France get the best from our business systems, processes and support functions. This is not a traditional IT Manager position. It is a highly business-facing role combining business systems, operational processes, user support, training, continuous improvement and team leadership . You will work closely with our branches and Shared Services teams to understand how people work, where they encounter challenges and how technology and better processes can make their jobs easier and our business more effective. What you will do Become a Business Systems Expert You will develop strong expertise in the applications supporting our European operations and become a trusted point of contact for our business users. A major focus will be our ERP environment, supporting processes such as: Purchasing and purchase orders Goods and invoice receipt Rental contracts Equipment on-hire and off-hire Recurring and final billing Credit notes and ad-hoc invoicing Customer, supplier and item master data You will also support the effective use of CRM, Microsoft 365 and other operational applications. Experience with inspHire, Zoho or Twinfield would be advantageous, but previous knowledge of our specific applications is not essential if you have strong ERP/business systems experience and learn quickly. Help People Get the Best From Technology You will work directly with colleagues across our branches to understand challenges, answer questions and identify better ways of working. That includes: Providing practical systems and process support Training new and existing users Developing SOPs, quick-reference guides and training materials Creating screen recordings and short training videos Building a structured, version-controlled knowledge library Identifying recurring problems and addressing their root causes Most importantly, you will explain the why , not only the how . Connect Systems With Business Reality Good systems only create good information when they are used correctly. You will therefore work closely with Operations, Sales, Finance, Fleet and other Shared Services functions to improve the quality and consistency of the processes behind our data. You will help us ensure that operational information, CRM pipelines, rental transactions, margins and management KPIs accurately reflect what is happening in the business. Listen, Challenge and Improve Our branches know their business and will bring you ideas and requirements. Your job is not simply to say yes. You will listen, understand the underlying need and assess whether the best answer is a change to a system, process, training or something else. For larger initiatives, you will help structure requirements, assess benefits, costs, effort and risks, and make clear recommendations to leadership. Lead a Small Team You will lead a developing Branch Support function, expected to include approximately three team members across business support and IT/helpdesk activities . This remains a hands-on role. You will lead the team while actively participating in support, training, problem solving and improvement initiatives yourself. Stay Curious Technology is changing quickly and we want to take advantage of it. You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious about tools such as Microsoft Copilot , automation and new ways technology can help colleagues work more effectively. The Person We Are Looking For Systems knowledge matters, but how you work with people matters just as much. You are someone who: Listens before proposing a solution Is patient and enjoys explaining things Can train and support colleagues with different levels of systems experience Builds credibility and strong working relationships Can persuade and influence without relying on hierarchy Is comfortable constructively challenging a request Is pragmatic and realistic about priorities, resources and costs Learns new business processes quickly Enjoys solving problems Is comfortable being visible and close to the operational business Is curious about technology and AI You should be equally comfortable discussing a process with a branch administrator, working through a systems problem with IT, understanding a commercial requirement from Sales or presenting a recommendation to leadership. European Scope The role supports operations across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France . Regular interaction with the branches is a fundamental part of the position. You should therefore be willing to travel across our European locations , build strong relationships with local teams and spend time understanding how our operations work in practice. Regular office presence is also expected, currently anticipated at up to three days per week at our office in Potsdam. Why This Role? This is an opportunity to shape a developing European support function rather than simply inherit an established helpdesk. You will have the opportunity to influence: How we use our business systems How we support and train users How processes are standardised across countries How knowledge is documented and shared How new technology and AI are adopted How Branch Support develops as our European organisation evolves If you enjoy bringing together people, processes and technology and want a role where you can see the practical impact of your work across the business, we would like to hear from you. What you will do

Become a Business Systems Expert

You will develop strong expertise in the applications supporting our European operations and become a trusted point of contact for our business users.

A major focus will be our ERP environment, supporting processes such as:

  • Purchasing and purchase orders

  • Goods and invoice receipt

  • Rental contracts

  • Equipment on-hire and off-hire

  • Recurring and final billing

  • Credit notes and ad-hoc invoicing

  • Customer, supplier and item master data

You will also support the effective use of CRM, Microsoft 365 and other operational applications.

That includes:

  • Providing practical systems and process support

  • Training new and existing users

  • Developing SOPs, quick-reference guides and training materials

  • Creating screen recordings and short training videos

  • Building a structured, version-controlled knowledge library

  • Identifying recurring problems and addressing their root causes

Most importantly, you will explain the why, not only the how.

Connect Systems With Business Reality

Good systems only create good information when they are used correctly.

You will therefore work closely with Operations, Sales, Finance, Fleet and other Shared Services functions to improve the quality and consistency of the processes behind our data.

You will help us ensure that operational information, CRM pipelines, rental transactions, margins and management KPIs accurately reflect what is happening in the business.

Listen, Challenge and Improve

Our branches know their business and will bring you ideas and requirements.

Your job is not simply to say yes.

You will listen, understand the underlying need and assess whether the best answer is a change to a system, process, training or something else.

For larger initiatives, you will help structure requirements, assess benefits, costs, effort and risks, and make clear recommendations to leadership.

You will lead a developing Branch Support function, expected to include approximately three team members across business support and IT/helpdesk activities.

Systems knowledge matters, but how you work with people matters just as much.

  • Builds credibility and strong working relationships

  • Can persuade and influence without relying on hierarchy

  • Is comfortable constructively challenging a request

  • Is pragmatic and realistic about priorities, resources and costs

  • Learns new business processes quickly

  • Enjoys solving problems

  • Is comfortable being visible and close to the operational business

European Scope

The role supports operations across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France.

Regular interaction with the branches is a fundamental part of the position. You should therefore be willing to travel across our European locations, build strong relationships with local teams and spend time understanding how our operations work in practice.

Regular office presence is also expected, currently anticipated at up to three days per week at our office in Potsdam.

This is an opportunity to shape a developing European support function rather than simply inherit an established helpdesk.

You will have the opportunity to influence:

  • How we use our business systems

  • How we support and train users

  • How processes are standardised across countries

  • How knowledge is documented and shared

  • How new technology and AI are adopted

  • How Branch Support develops as our European organisation evolves

title: AI/ML Researcher
description: Über YLAB Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden. Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene. Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten. Warum YLAB Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard. Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt. Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt. Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch. Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden. Was wir bieten Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht. Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst. Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt. Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln. Über die Rolle Wie versteht ein Sprachmodell eine Vierjährige? Und wie erklärt es ihr die Welt, ohne sie zu überfordern? Dazu gibt es kaum Paper und keine Benchmarks. Genau da setzt du an. Du bist unsere erste dedizierte Research-Stelle. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von KI, Sprache und Pädagogik, mit echten Familien statt Laborbedingungen und mit direktem Draht ins Produkt. Was dich erwartet: offene Fragen mit Substanz, ein Fachbeirat aus Bildung und Psychologie und die Freiheit, Studien so zu bauen, wie sie sein müssen. Wie du uns helfen kannst Du entwirfst und machst Studien mit Kindern und Familien. Von der Beobachtung im Wohnzimmer bis zum strukturierten Test. Du baust Methoden, um altersgerechte Antworten zu bewerten: Was heißt verständlich, was heißt zu viel? Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Modell- und Produktentscheidungen, zusammen mit Engineering und Pädagogik. Du behältst die Forschung im Blick (Child-Computer Interaction, Speech, LLM-Evals) und holst rein, was uns weiterbringt. Du teilst, was wir lernen. Wir forschen nicht für die Schublade. Melde dich, wenn: Du hast einen Research-Hintergrund, etwa HCI, Psychologie, Linguistik oder ML. Du hast schon mit Nutzer:innen geforscht, am besten mit Kindern. Du kannst beides: Interviews auswerten und saubere Metriken bauen. Du schreibst klar. Für Paper genauso wie für Produktentscheidungen. Du magst es, wenn deine Forschung nächste Woche im Prototyp steckt. Eher nicht, wenn: du Forschung als Selbstzweck siehst oder zwei Jahre Vorlauf brauchst, bevor etwas testbar ist. description: Deep Blue Recruitment is working with an international technology company looking to appoint an experienced Senior Privacy Counsel to join its legal team. Operating in the enterprise technology sector, the business develops software and digital solutions for customers across a range of industries. With continued investment in emerging technologies, including AI, data protection is becoming an increasingly important consideration in how the business develops its products, manages risk and works with customers. We're looking for a commercially minded privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, understanding how technology works and finding practical solutions to complex legal questions. This is a broad, hands-on role combining privacy advisory work, commercial support and the continued development of internal data protection processes. What You'll Be Doing Advise colleagues across the business on a broad range of privacy and data protection matters, providing clear, commercially focused legal guidance. Work closely with product, technology and commercial teams on the development of new services, ensuring privacy considerations are addressed early in the process. Support the negotiation of commercial agreements, particularly around data processing, international transfers, customer relationships and third-party arrangements. Advise on GDPR and other applicable international data protection regulations, helping the business understand and manage its obligations across different markets. Provide legal guidance on emerging technologies, including AI, and the implications of new products and data processing activities from a privacy perspective. Review and improve existing privacy policies, internal procedures and governance frameworks to ensure they remain practical and fit for purpose. Work alongside information security and IT teams on data governance, risk assessments and privacy-related incidents. Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency of privacy operations, including through automation and better internal processes. Monitor regulatory developments affecting technology businesses, particularly around data protection, AI and digital services. Provide training and guidance to colleagues across the organisation, helping non-legal teams understand their responsibilities when handling personal data. What They're Looking For A qualified lawyer with approximately 4-10 years experience specialising in data protection, privacy or technology law, gained in private practice, in-house or a combination of both. Experience advising technology businesses, ideally with exposure to software, AI, digital products or other data-intensive environments. A good understanding of artificial intelligence technologies and the legal and regulatory challenges associated with their development and use. Experience advising on commercial agreements involving personal data, international transfers and complex data processing arrangements. Comfortable working directly with product, engineering and technical stakeholders, with the ability to understand complex issues and provide clear, practical legal advice. A commercial approach to risk management, recognising that the role of legal is to help the business find workable solutions rather than simply identify problems. Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently. Experience working within an international business or advising on privacy matters across multiple jurisdictions would be beneficial. Why Consider This Opportunity? This is an opportunity to join an international technology business where privacy plays an important role in how the company operates, develops its products and works with customers. You'll have a broad remit, working closely with different teams across the organisation on a range of commercial, operational and regulatory matters, including some of the challenges emerging technologies bring to data protection. If you're a privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, has an interest in technology and takes a practical approach to solving legal challenges, we'd be interested in hearing from you. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Project Management team

The Project Management team takes hx customers from signed contract to live in production. We work in cross-functional pods alongside delivery engineers and solution architects, and we own the customer relationship day to day: the plan, the budget, the risks and the conversations that go with them. We work with some of the most sophisticated insurers in the world, including Lloyd’s syndicates, Tier 1 carriers, reinsurers and MGAs. We are moving to a shared, AI-first way of working, where one set of skills is used and improved by the whole team, and we are looking for people who want to help build it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead delivery across the projects in our Strategic pod, holding commercials to plan and surfacing risks early.

  • Lead and develop the people who report to you, so they progress.

  • Spot where a project can grow, and bring cross-sell and upsell opportunities to the account team.

  • Lead internal projects that change how the pod delivers, and feed them into our shared delivery framework.

  • Shape how AI is used in our delivery workflows, beyond your own work.

  • Work alongside the pod’s technical lead, so technical delivery can focus on technical problems.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Run several projects at once with commercial accountability.

  • Led people, through line management or equivalent, and be able to point to someone who progressed.

  • Changed how a team works and be able to show it was adopted.

  • Built or shaped AI-enabled workflows, and be able to explain what you learned.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer to direct work from a distance, rather than stay close enough to the detail to make sound commercial and delivery calls.

  • You’re more comfortable following an established playbook than building one as the team and the product evolve.

  • You see leadership as managing tasks rather than developing people and holding them to a high standard.

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  • Initial call with our Talent team - 30 minutes

hxer’s are at the centre of everything we build. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">At Roku, the UI Systems team builds the high-performance engines and core graphics infrastructure that power millions of devices. We own the low-level C++ frameworks, rendering pipelines, and system architectures that enable smooth navigation and rich animations. Our work sits at the intersection of hardware and software, where we optimize graphics rendering, memory management, and layout engines to ensure a consistent, lightning-fast experience across our entire device portfolio. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment, partnering closely with firmware and silicon teams to push the boundaries of what’s possible on embedded hardware.</p> <h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key architect of the core systems that underpin Roku’s user experience. You will design and implement performance-critical code within our UI engine, focusing on graphics primitives, memory efficiency, and hardware acceleration. You’ll tackle complex systems-level challenges—such as optimizing frame rates on resource-constrained hardware and building robust APIs for higher-level frameworks. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive on low-level systems programming, care about performance down to the microsecond, and want to build the high-performance foundations that power the future of television.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Architect and optimize core C++ UI frameworks and rendering engines to ensure buttery-smooth performance across a diverse range of hardware profiles.</li> <li>Lead technical investigations into system-level bottlenecks, memory leaks, and GPU/CPU synchronization issues.</li> <li>Develop and maintain low-level graphics APIs and layout systems that serve as the backbone for Roku’s application ecosystem.</li> <li>Integrate AI/ML capabilities at the systems level, leveraging generative AI tools to optimize code generation and automate performance profiling.</li> <li>Collaborate with firmware and driver teams to leverage hardware-specific optimizations and ensure seamless integration with the underlying OS.</li> <li>Mentor junior developers through deep-dive code reviews, architectural design sessions, and technical documentation of core systems.</li> <li>Drive engineering excellence by implementing advanced debugging tools, automated performance regression suites, and modern C++ best practices.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>We’re excited if you have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Minimum of 5+ years of software engineering experience with a heavy focus on C++ (C++14/17/20).</li> <li>Deep understanding of systems programming, including memory management, multi-threading, and hardware-software abstraction layers.</li> <li>Experience with graphics APIs (e.g., OpenGL, Vulkan, or proprietary embedded graphics stacks) and rendering pipelines.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python for tooling and automation, with a working knowledge of BrightScript or JavaScript being a significant plus.</li> <li>Strong root cause analysis skills, specifically using tools like GDB, Valgrind, or platform-specific profilers.</li> <li>Knowledge of AI applications and hands-on experience using generative AI tools to accelerate systems-level development.</li> <li>A proactive mindset with a passion for squeezing every drop of performance out of embedded systems and a commitment to data-driven optimization.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. description: <p><strong>About Team &amp; About Role</strong><br><br>Rubrik's sales organization helps hospitals, banks, schools and government agencies stay resilient against cyberattacks, malicious insiders and operational disruption, and unstructured data on NAS is one of the fastest-growing and most exposed corners of the data estate. As Regional Director for NAS Cloud Direct, you'll build and lead the team of Product Line Specialists who own this number across your region, and you'll set the standard for how Rubrik wins in this market. You'll work hand in hand with Core Account Executives, Sales Engineering, Sales Development, Channel Development and our partners within the One Rubrik selling motion, with the enablement, autonomy and ownership to take your team, your career and your earnings as far as your results allow. You'll also be the consolidated voice of the field and the customer back to Product Management, Product Marketing and PnP.<br><br><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own bookings growth and quota attainment for NAS Cloud Direct across the region, building a regional plan that helps more organizations protect massive volumes of unstructured data without adding on-prem backup infrastructure</li> <li>Recruit, hire, coach and develop a team of NAS Cloud Direct Sales Specialists, raising the bar on daily pipeline generation, net new logo acquisition and expansion within the existing Rubrik base</li> <li>Lead from the front on strategic opportunities, joining key deals and guiding your team through complex data center and cloud design conversations and CxO-level selling</li> <li>Run a disciplined forecast and weekly operating rhythm, using MEDDPICC and COtM to keep pipeline honest and give leadership a number they can plan around</li> <li>Align with regional leaders in Core AE, Sales Engineering, Sales Development and Channel Development on coverage and account strategy, so specialists and Core AEs win together rather than compete for the same deal</li> <li>Build repeatable, partner-led momentum with distributors, resellers and VARs, turning co-sell relationships into a growing share of regional pipeline</li> <li>Champion NAS Cloud Direct inside and outside Rubrik, enabling the field on positioning, objection handling and competitive differentiation so more teams can sell it with confidence</li> <li>Bring market and customer feedback to Product Management and Product Marketing, shaping what we build next and how we take it to market, and share what's working with fellow Product Line Specialist leaders so the whole organization learns faster</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience You'll Need</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years leading quota-carrying field sales teams in technology, with a record of consistently overachieving as a leader and as a seller</li> <li>Experience selling or leading sales of data protection, storage, cloud infrastructure or NAS-related solutions into enterprise and mid-enterprise accounts</li> <li>A track record of building pipeline across many accounts and verticals and landing net new logos, and of coaching others to do the same</li> <li>Comfort guiding sellers as they position a technical product in complex data center and cloud environments and build champions with technical and business buyers</li> <li>Experience working with channel partners, distributors and resellers to co-sell and grow a territory</li> <li>Forecasting discipline, a structured approach to deal qualification, and experience recruiting and developing high-performing sellers</li> <li>Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, and the ability to influence peers, executives and cross-functional partners in sensitive situations</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exposure to unstructured data challenges and enterprise NAS platforms</li> <li>Experience leading product-specialist or overlay sales teams alongside Core AE organizations</li> <li>Familiarity with the competitive landscape in data protection and cloud storage</li> <li>Working knowledge of MEDDPICC for sales qualification and the COtM sales methodology</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2>Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation</h2> <p>Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.</p> <p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/rubrik-inc/mycompany/verification/">Linkedin</a> | <a href="https://twitter.com/rubrikinc">X (formerly Twitter)</a> | <a href="https://www.instagram.com/rubrikinc/" target="_blank">Instagram</a> |&nbsp;<a href="https://www.rubrik.com">Rubrik.com</a></p> <h2>Inclusion @ Rubrik</h2> <p>At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST. We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application. About the role We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will: Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination). Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance. Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature. Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure. Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas. Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols. Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services. Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy. Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails. To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more! What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure. A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs. Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources. Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning. Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka. Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based). AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment. Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two. The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement. Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers. You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements. You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering. This role is not a good fit for you if: You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy. You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team. You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will: Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised. Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it. Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary. Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. Show me the benefits Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute system design interview focusing on your architecture, infrastructure and problem-solving skills. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!
