Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. This role focuses heavily on building services for internal / external users consumption. It is absolutely critical to have extensive API design and development experience, expertise in OLAP systems and to be able to work in Kotlin. About the role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will:

  • Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination).

  • Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance.

  • Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.

  • Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.

  • Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.

  • Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.

  • Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.

  • Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.

  • Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more!

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure.

  • A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.

  • Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.

  • Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.

  • Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.

  • Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).

  • AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.

  • Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.

  • The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers.

  • You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements.

  • You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy.

  • You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team.

  • You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

  • Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised.

  • Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it.

  • Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis.

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options.

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Core skills test: An async AI-assisted programming test to assess your coding fundamentals.

  3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat deep diving into your experience.

  4. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute system design interview focusing on your architecture, infrastructure and problem-solving skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • This role focuses heavily on building services for internal / external users consumption. It is absolutely critical to have extensive API design and development experience, expertise in OLAP systems and to be able to work in Kotlin. Ensure your CV reflects clearly of the actual experience you have across those areas.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

The Role

This is our first Director of Employee Relations & Compliance for EMEA: a senior, hands-on role owning ER casework, employment law compliance and jurisdictional risk across Germany, the UK, Sweden, Italy, Spain and France.

Based in London, you'll be the standing authority on ER practice in the region. You'll own complex casework end to end, build dedicated ER capability where none exists today, and extend the strength we already have in Stockholm. You'll report to the EMEA People Director, with a path to running an independent function reporting to the CHRO as it scales.

What You'll Do

ER leadership and casework

  • Own complex casework end to end across every market: investigations, grievances, disciplinaries, PIPs and terminations for cause, to a consistently high, legally sound standard.

  • Be the escalation point when a matter turns complex, contested or legally weighted, for Local People Advisory and the wider People org.

  • Hold the bar on case handling: written scoping, contemporaneous documentation, balance-of-probabilities findings, and independent second review of any outcome that could end employment.

Compliance and jurisdictional risk

  • Own employment and ER compliance across all six markets: statutory notice and consultation, works council and union engagement, mandatory filings and register-keeping, and local implementation of the EU Whistleblowing Directive (disclosures run through a separate channel).

  • Maintain the EMEA jurisdiction playbook and horizon-scan for legal changes, flagging implications to leadership early.

  • Engage Employment Counsel at the right moment with a clear written scope, not as a late rescue.

  • Note: comp-related compliance (pay equity, gender pay gap, benefits) sits with Rewards.

Team and capability building

  • Build dedicated ER capability across EMEA, prioritised by risk and case volume, on the foundation of the Stockholm team.

  • Certify and calibrate anyone running a formal ER process, keeping casework consistent as the team grows.

Stakeholder partnership and consistency

  • Act as the quality check for Local People Advisory across EMEA (who sit in People Operations), signing off local ER and compliance work without managing those roles day to day.

  • Partner with People Partners, People Operations, People Tech and Rewards so policy and tooling reflect what EMEA markets need.

  • Turn case patterns into a regular, actionable view for People leadership.

  • Work with your NORAM and APAC counterparts on one shared case taxonomy, system and calibration forum, representing EMEA's regulatory and cultural nuance in global standards.

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience leading ER, HR compliance or similar at a fast-scaling company, ideally across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.

  • Deep, practical knowledge of employment law and ER practice across several of these markets, and comfort working outside your home jurisdiction.

  • A track record of investigations, disciplinaries and terminations that hold up to scrutiny: calm, neutral and thorough under pressure.

  • Experience building an ER or compliance function from the ground up: process, hiring, and getting a distributed team to one standard.

  • Confidence as a senior, independent voice, comfortable escalating to and influencing leadership.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to London, able to travel across EMEA.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every formal ER matter across the region handled fairly, consistently and to a legally sound standard.

  • A resourced, capable EMEA ER team, built out from London to the markets that need it.

  • The wider People org treats this function as the standing authority on ER and compliance, not a bottleneck.

  • A function ready to stand on its own, with a credible case for direct CHRO reporting.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Direct Mail is one of our highest-potential channels and we’re hiring a leader to turn it into a scaled, precise, and defensible growth engine. We’re looking for a Head of Direct Mail to own the channel end-to-end: creative, sends, logistics, offers, and reporting, sourcing the data pipeline and user-data enrichment that let us target the right customer, with the right offer, at the right moment.

You'll lead the channel's dedicated analysts and work with our creative team. Your job is to set the direction: decide who we mail, with what offer and when, commission and challenge the selection and response models, and hold every campaign to CAC and LTV targets.

Standalone direct mail roles with this kind of budget and autonomy are rare. If you've got significant experience in acquisition mail and want to build a channel your own way, at a profitable business with the product range and analytical capabilities to make it work, this is the role.

What we’re looking for:

Essential:

  • 5+ years in direct mail, including at least 2–3 years owning an acquisition DM programme end to end: strategy, budget, data, production and results.

  • A track record of mailing cold prospects at meaningful scale. You'll be able to talk through the volumes, budgets, response rates and CPAs you've been accountable for.

  • Experience procuring data: working with data suppliers on list selection, screening, enrichment and cost.

  • Deep knowledge of the DM supply chain: print, lettershop, Royal Mail products (Advertising Mail, Mailmark, partially addressed, door drops) and suppression (MPS, goneaways, deceased).

  • A strongly commercial approach. You build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, own the channel P&L, and measure spend on CAC, ROI and payback rather than pieces mailed.

  • Strong analytical judgement. You design test cells and holdouts, read results critically, and understand response and propensity modelling well enough to brief analysts, challenge their work and turn it into mailing decisions.

  • Experience managing suppliers: tendering, negotiating, setting SLAs and keeping several partners to schedule.

  • The ability to run a multi-drop campaign calendar across products, segments, creative, compliance sign-off, production and mail dates.

  • Experience leading analysts and working closely with creative teams.

  • A clear communicator who earns the trust of finance, risk, compliance and data teams.

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow.

Desirable:

  • Experience in acquisition mail in financial services, especially credit cards or loans, including prescreened or pre-approved offers and risk-based targeting.

  • Experience standing up a data pipeline or enrichment stack (first-party + third-party / bureau data)

  • Experience building a channel or function from scratch

  • Background hiring and developing an analytics or design team

You’re a good fit if you’re:

  • Acquisition-minded: you're energised by finding new customers, not re-contacting existing ones.

  • Commercially driven: you measure success in incremental LTV and payback, not response rate alone.

  • A first-principles thinker: you argue from data and clean experiments, not received wisdom

  • Organised: you can run several drops across multiple suppliers and still hit mailing deadlines.

  • Energised by greenfield: you’d rather build the engine than tune someone else’s

What you’ll be doing

Strategy and commercials

  • Own the direct mail strategy and set volume, response and payback targets anchored to LTV.

  • Own the channel P&L: forecasting, budget and CAC/LTV discipline.

  • Decide how far and how fast to scale, based on the economics.

Data and targeting

  • Source and buy prospect data from bureaus and brokers, and combine it with our first-party data.

  • Direct the analysts building the response and propensity models that decide who we mail, with what offer and when.

  • Work with risk analysts to shape offers around eligibility and lifetime value.

Campaigns and supplier management

  • Plan and run the campaign calendar, from data selection to the mail landing on doormats.

  • Select, negotiate with and manage print and postal suppliers on cost, quality and turnaround.

  • Brief the creative team on packs, copy and offers, and take them through compliance sign-off.

Reporting & Team

  • Build the reporting that ties sends to funnel, revenue and LTV and report on channel performance

  • Partner with data, product, risk, finance and the creative team to unlock targeting and offers

  • Hire and develop the team as the channel scales, and use AI to let a small team punch above its weight

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

raw.title: Product Lead
raw.description:
📍 Manchester (Hybrid) | 💰 £70,000 - £90,000

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, and we're doing that by giving UK estate agencies world-class technology.

Our Product team is at the heart of that mission. We find the most valuable problems to solve, ship quality solutions, and measure the impact along the way. As we grow, we're bringing in a Product Lead to own a significant product area and help raise the standard of product across the team. You'll have real ownership, a team that collaborates well, and the freedom to make decisions, not just ship someone else's roadmap.


What you'll be doing

In this high-impact role, you will oversee a core domain that spans multiple product lines. You will drive strategy across critical functional areas, while directly managing and developing a team of Product Managers.

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for your product area, with autonomy from day one to deliver commercial success.

  • Line-manage and develop Product Managers in the team: 1:1s, coaching, and helping people grow.

  • Set the standard for discovery, prioritisation, and stakeholder communication across the product function.

A bit about you

  • Have owned an (ideally B2B) software product end to end, and are able to evidence measurable outcomes (revenue, retention, adoption or conversion).

  • Experience managing and mentoring other PMs. You know what good looks like and you help others get there.

  • Confidence working without a lot of direction. You can set your own course and bring people with you.

  • Are customer obsessed, love spending time with customers and have run discovery directly with them, working alongside a product designer or UX researcher.

  • Strong communication skills - you can explain what you built, why you built it, and what it achieved.

  • A drive to improve not just your product area, but how the whole team operates.

You should apply for this role if...

  • You want a real domain to own, not a feature set.

  • You want to keep building product while growing people.

  • You like a blank page. It is a new role, so you define what the Product Lead role looks like here and set the standard for discovery, prioritisation and stakeholder communication.

  • You work better without close direction. You will have autonomy from day one and are expected to set your own course.

  • You have already made AI part of how you work - or are experimenting with it in your personal life. Day-to-day and strategically, AI usage at Street Group is an expectation.


You should not apply for this role if...

  • You are used to working within strict guidelines and are not used to autonomy.

  • You want to be solely hands on or off, as this roles requires both at various points.

  • You have not managed, mentored, or coached PMs before.

Why Street Group
Product actually matters here. You'll have real ownership, a team that collaborates well, and the freedom to make decisions, not just ship someone else's roadmap.


Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working, you can work from home up to 3 days per week

🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R. A £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)

💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth

📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development

🎂 Your birthday on us. We pay, you stay away

🙋 ‘Give something back’. You get 2 paid days volunteering on us

👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay

🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured

🧘 Regular well-being initiatives

🕒 Flexible working hours

🚂 Public transport season ticket loans

🌷 Paid menopause leave

🌞 Holiday buying scheme

🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition

👥 Be a part of something bigger. Everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day

👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology

🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space and office dogs welcome!

🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon

🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours

🚴 Cycle to work scheme

🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme

🌍 Feel good about sustainability. We're a climate-positive company!


Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and were about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

 

Salary
£70,000 - £90,000 dependent on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

 

Interview Process

3 stages = An introductory call with one of our Talent team > Skills-based interview > Final values-based interview.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made, or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

 

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you. Your skills, experience, and values. We don’t want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist (Viator)
description: <p><strong>About Tripadvisor&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.</p> <p>As our new <strong>Senior Machine Learning Scientist </strong>you’ll be joining the <strong>Viator R&amp;D Team. </strong>This team is evolving the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.</p> <p><br><br></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>You’ll serve as a key technical lead and pod architect within our core discovery engine. You will independently own and execute the machine learning strategy for major product capabilities—such as Search, Retrieval, Ranking, or Content AI—that power how millions of users discover and plan their travel itineraries.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This Senior Machine Learning Scientist role bridges the gap between state-of-the-art (SOTA) research and robust, production-grade engineering. You will navigate technical ambiguity, implement custom algorithmic components, and explicitly map offline model metrics directly to business KPIs like booking conversion and user engagement. If you are a relentlessly curious scientist who excels at rapid prototyping, practical SOTA deployment, and multiplying the capabilities of your peers, this role is for you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Leadership &amp; Custom Implementation:</strong> Act as the technical lead for specific ML projects within your pod. Design and implement custom model components or loss functions that don't exist "off-the-shelf," breaking down massive research goals into deliverable, iterative milestones.</li> <li><strong>Optimization &amp; SOTA Scouting:</strong> Evaluate the global research landscape to conduct cost-benefit analyses on new architectures, balancing model complexity against inference speed, memory usage, and execution costs (such as token consumption). Optimize models for production using techniques like quantization and distillation.</li> <li><strong>Operational Frameworks &amp; Rigor:</strong> Tailor Golden Datasets and leaderboards with minimal supervision, and implement rigorous validation automation (such as backtesting and slice-based evaluation) to prevent data leakage, over-fitting, and production regressions.</li> <li><strong>Engineering Partnership &amp; Handovers:</strong> Collaborate closely with Engineering Leads to ensure compute/GPU infrastructure supports model requirements. Clearly define model failure modes, edge cases, and confidence thresholds—to enable SWE partners to build robust fallback systems.</li> <li><strong>Applied Debugging &amp; Guardrails:</strong> Diagnose complex algorithmic bugs and implement automated checks for "Silent Failures" (e.g., concept drift or production feature distribution shifts). Lead team-level post-mortems and resolve blocking corrective actions.</li> <li><strong>Career Multiplier:</strong> Formally mentor mid-level and associate ML scientists, reviewing their experimental logic to ensure high scientific rigor while guiding them through applied ML and production constraints.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills &amp; Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a highly quantitative field.</li> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years of industry experience developing, validating, and deploying large-scale ML models in production environments.</li> <li><strong>Algorithmic Expertise:</strong> Strong practical and theoretical foundation in machine learning techniques, feature engineering, and deep learning paradigms.</li> <li><strong>SOTA Adaptability:</strong> Proven ability to tweak, hybridize, and adapt existing state-of-the-art architectures to solve non-linear business problems. Experience with multi-task learning (MTL), ranking, Content AI stacks, Agentic AI etc is highly desirable.</li> <li><strong>Technical Stack:</strong> Mastery of Python and deep learning frameworks (such as PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, or TensorFlow) alongside familiarity with data versioning and experiment tracking tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired</strong></p> <ul> <li>Next-generation retrieval pipelines, multi-stage ranking systems and Content AI stacks.</li> <li>Advanced sequential recommendation systems designed to model real-time user session dynamics.</li> <li>Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), knowledge graphs, and multi-modal representation learning to map travel entities.</li> <li>Generative AI and Agentic AI workflows to improve conversational discovery experiences.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We Offer&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Competitive compensation packages</strong> (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses</li> <li><strong>“Work your way”</strong> with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.</li> <li><strong>Flexible schedule</strong>. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.</li> <li><strong>Donation matching.</strong> Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.</li> <li><strong>Tuition assistance.</strong> Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.</li> <li><strong>Lifestyle benefit.</strong> An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.</li> <li><strong>Travel perks.</strong> We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.</li> <li><strong>Employee assistance program. </strong>We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.</li> <li><strong>Health benefits.</strong> We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.</li> <li><strong>Generous referral scheme. </strong>Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Cultural Pillars:</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Traveler first</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Execution is our edge</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>We succeed together</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at ----- <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at ----- We have all the answers!</p> <p><br><br></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p> <p>#LI-AMCVAY</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

The French market is one of Dust’s most important growth levers, and the Marketing team plays a central role in supporting pipeline generation through events, content and account-based activations.

As field marketing specialist, France, you will be the execution owner for Dust’s local Marketing activities. Working closely with the France Marketing Lead, you will turn defined priorities into high-quality events, localized webinars, social media, content and partner marketing activations that support Sales, BDRs and pipeline generation.

The France Marketing Lead owns the strategy, budget, programme selection and priorities. You will own execution, coordination, content delivery and continuous improvement across the French Marketing motion.

You will be part of a growing Marketing team across the US, UK and France, managed by the Global Head of Marketing.

Key Responsibilities

Own the execution of the French event and webinar programme

  • Execute conferences, Dust-owned events and localized webinars selected and scoped by the France Marketing Lead.

  • Coordinate the preparation, stakeholders, content, landing pages and logistics needed for a smooth delivery.

  • Work closely with Sales and BDRs to prepare target accounts, follow-up plans and event-related content.

  • Collect feedback, measure performance and document learnings after each activity.

Own French social media and content activation

  • Own social media execution for Dust around events, campaigns and key French-market topics.

  • Support AEs with relevant content and messaging for their LinkedIn activity.

  • Coordinate with Global Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Design and external media partners to deliver relevant content for French enterprise audiences.

  • Turn events, customer conversations and market insights into reusable content, including customer stories, blog posts, videos, YouTube content and Sales assets.

  • Provide execution and logistical support for regional partner marketing activities within the strategy, selection and budget defined by the France Marketing Lead.

  • Support Growth with French-market content for ABM, webinars and paid campaigns.

  • Produce or reformat assets such as e-books, landing pages, customer content and campaign materials.

  • Connect event, content and partner marketing activities to target account engagement and pipeline generation.

Coordinate cross-functional Marketing initiatives

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive Marketing tasks , Build Dust agents and workflows to support research, event preparation, content repurposing, Sales enablement, reporting and follow-up.

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B Marketing, ideally across Field Marketing, Event Marketing, Content Marketing or Product Marketing, preferably in SaaS or technology.

  • End-to-end event ownership with the ability to plan and deliver conferences, executive events and Dust-owned events, from preparation through execution and post-event follow-up.

  • Strong content and social media skills with experience creating or repurposing content for enterprise audiences across social media, landing pages, customer stories, YouTube, Sales enablement and executive LinkedIn profiles.

  • Commercial and pipeline mindset with a clear understanding of how events, content and account-based activities support Sales, BDRs, direct pipeline and partner-led growth.

  • Excellent communication skills in French and English, both written and spoken. You can write clearly and accurately, adapt your tone to different audiences and communicate credibly with enterprise executives.

  • Generalist and hands-on approach. You are comfortable moving between event ownership, content creation, Sales preparation, webinars, campaign assets and operational coordination.

  • Self-starter mentality. You take initiative, make decisions, solve problems and own outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do.

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

raw.title: Workplace Experience - Healthcare Sites Development Manager
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Healthcare Sites Development Manager

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us — We're obsessed with helping our members live healthier

  • Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, seeking our mission success above all else.

  • Member & customer-led: obsessively focused on solving members & customers problems and creating the most delightful experiences.

🏆 How we build excellence — We hire the best people and give them platform to succeed

  • Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density.

  • Distributed ownership: accountable enlightened despots, everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radically transparent: all information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

🤝 How we grow together — We help each other improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

  • Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care and support teammates.

  • Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback combined with praises to help each other grow professionally.

  • Bold & creative contrarians: think differently to achieve greatness, try new approaches.

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

  • Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time.

  • Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality.

💡 The Missions

Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in Île-de-France, built to rethink occupational health with Alan's technology, for the benefit of employees and of healthcare professionals (HPs).

Its first medical centre opened at Valmy (Paris 10th) in April 2026, and 4 sites are already running.

Prévenir is about to scale fast: the ambition is to open several new small centres around Paris in 2027 (Seine-et-Marne, Val-d'Oise), first inside ready-to-operate sites, then in premises of its own (rented or bought), including a flagship centre in Paris. The exact plan is still being shaped, and you will help shape it.

We are looking for someone senior and visionary enough to carry the vision and strategy of Prévenir's sites from day one, while being happy (and excited) to be hands-on as much as needed, with a start-up mindset. Health, member experience and innovation are at the heart of the role.

You would join Alan as a full-time Alaner in the Workplace team: you work for Alan, not only for Prévenir. At first, most of your time goes to Prévenir: opening new sites, making them compliant and ready for patients with a real Prevenir's spirit, running the centres day to day with the center managers, and building the vendors, budgets and playbook that will let it grow from 4 to many more sites.

Prévenir is a separate entity from Alan: it signs its own leases and contracts, and you prepare, negotiate and advise on its behalf.

You will work alongside the Facility Manager in charge of Alan's offices at Valmy, and turn what you learn into playbooks, checklists and templates (openings, fit-out, vendors, compliance) that serve Prévenir's centres as much as Alan's own offices.

The position is based in Paris, with regular field visits across Île-de-France (Paris, Seine-et-Marne, Hauts-de-Seine, Val-d'Oise), and requires an onsite or field presence at least 4 days per week.

👀 More specificities on the profile we're looking for (level range targeted on our level grid: C1-D)

Detailed missions

Set the vision

  • Define and carry the vision and strategy for Prévenir's sites from day one: site model, technical and experience standards, and a 2–3 year real-estate roadmap, alongship Prévenir's and Alan's leadership and kept up to date as the plan evolves

  • Bring innovation: test new centre formats (shared, modular or temporary sites), and have a smart use of AI to make each opening faster, cheaper and better for HPs and patients

Open and build new sites

  • Find and technically qualify new sites: define search criteria with the Occupational Health team, visit candidate sites, and give a clear go / no-go recommendation with an estimated cost

  • Open small centres inside ready-to-operate sites: check that the host site works for medical use, agree the terms with the host operator (services, charges, service levels, who does what), do the light set-up and prepare the opening

  • Prepare and negotiate leases with Legal and Finance, and be the single operational point of contact for landlords, architects and vendors

  • When relevant, lead fit-out works end to end: brief and manage architects, project managers and contractors, plan backwards from the opening date, secure administrative and safety authorisations, manage acceptance and close snags

  • Contribute to the rent vs buy thinking by providing technical due diligence on any potential acquisition (condition of the building, works to expect, regulatory constraints, running costs)

Make every centre medical-ready, unique, safe and healthy

  • Make every site ready for patients: consultation rooms, patient flows, confidentiality (acoustics), hygiene and cleaning, medical waste, hand-washing points, IT / network and badge access set up with the IT team

  • Own the safety and security of every centre, for patients, HPs and visitors: access control, intrusion alarms and video surveillance where relevant (in line with GDPR), fire safety, evacuation procedures and drills, first-aid kits and defibrillators where required, and clear procedures for incidents and for HPs working alone

  • Put prevention at the heart of the run: identify the main risk areas of each centre (fire safety, HVAC and air quality, water, electrical, access control), build and run the preventive maintenance calendar, plan the mandatory periodic checks and keep each site's safety register up to date

Run the centres day to day

  • Run the day-to-day for existing and new centres with the center managers (ASSTs): sort and diagnose requests, fix what can be fixed, send the rest to the right contractor, and follow each intervention until it is done and checked

  • Own the logistical run of the centres in partnership with the center managers: supplies, snacks, mail, printing, small furniture and IT equipment, access and badges, cleaning. Agree a clear split of who does what and give them simple routines, checklists and documentation so they become autonomous

  • Create and keep alive the Prévenir spirit in every centre, as the Workplace team does for Alan its own offices: a welcoming, consistent and on-brand place for HPs, ASSTs and patients, using their feedback to keep improving it

Manage vendors, budgets and playbooks

  • Build a standard vendor panel (maintenance, fire safety, cleaning, medical waste, access control, furniture) with SLAs, penalties and exit terms. Run tenders and invoice checks, and reuse contracts across sites

  • Own the budget with Finance and the Occupational Health team: capex (fit-out, equipment, furniture) and opex (rent, charges, maintenance) per site, monthly follow-up, and realistic figures to feed the medical centres business model

  • Track, improve and document: run a simple dashboard (open requests, intervention times, openings progress, budget), keep the equipment inventory and maintenance log, automate repetitive follow-ups with AI and tools, and write the opening playbook and technical checklist reused for each new site

Be a full member of the Workplace team

  • Take part in the team's rituals and priorities, work with Alan's Workplace scope and join the on-call rotation (daily Office Management tasks)

Key outcomes by 1 year

  • A vision and a 2–3 year real-estate roadmap for Prévenir's sites are shared and approved by Prévenir's leadership and Alan within the first 3 months, and kept up to date

  • Existing centres are under control: contracts, leases, mandatory checks, equipment, open requests and risks are mapped and documented, with no missed regulatory check or expired contract

  • Preventive maintenance plans and safety registers are live on every centre, with at least 3 prevention areas identified, each with an action plan and KPIs

  • One single channel logs and tracks requests from the centres, each with an owner and a deadline; resolution time is measured and decreasing; a dashboard tracks requests, openings and budget; at least 3 recurring tasks are automated

  • The new centres planned for 2027 open on time, with safety, accessibility and authorisations validated before the first patient and a budget under control

  • A replicable opening playbook, a building technical checklist, a standard vendor panel and standard contract templates are in place and reused across sites

  • Every centre feels like Prévenir, is safe and secure (access control, alarms and emergency procedures in place and tested, drills done on time), and is healthy.

  • At least one innovation (new centre format, building tech or AI use case) has been tested in a centre, with clear results on cost, speed or HP and patient experience

You may be a great fit if you are:

  • A multi-site Facility / Technical Manager (6–10 years of experience) in a network of regulated, public-access sites: clinics, medical or radiology centres, labs, dental or health-centre networks, nurseries, fitness, retail networks

  • A real-estate project manager in charge of network expansion and site openings, with a real sensitivity to the run

  • A head of technical services of a clinic or private hospital who wants to move to a growth environment

  • A works / fit-out project manager (chef de projet travaux, maîtrise d'ouvrage) with strong ERP experience and some maintenance and run exposure

  • A site or contract manager at an FM service provider (healthcare accounts) who wants to move in-house, or a Workplace / Facility Manager in a scale-up who has led several office openings or moves

What we're looking for

  • Solid technical understanding of buildings: HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety systems, doors and access control, and the ability to challenge a technician or an architect

  • Proven experience of opening or fitting out sites: works follow-up with architects, project managers and contractors, planning, acceptance, snags

  • Knowledge of the French regulatory framework for public-access buildings (ERP classification, safety commission, works authorisation, accessibility, mandatory periodic checks, safety register)

  • Good knowledge of site safety and security: access control, intrusion alarms, video surveillance (and related GDPR rules), evacuation and emergency procedures, incident management

  • Lease and landlord management: you can read a lease, understand who pays and does what, and negotiate with landlords and agents

  • Proven vendor and contract management (SLAs, penalties, price indexation, tenders, invoice control) and budget ownership (capex / opex per site, total cost of ownership)

  • Project management of several sites in parallel, with strong prioritisation, including urgent incidents

  • Ability to work with senior and varied stakeholders: HPs and doctors, directors, Legal, Finance, IT, landlords, architects

  • Senior enough to set a vision and a strategy, and to carry and defend it with Prévenir's leadership and Alan, with a start-up mindset: frugal, fast, comfortable building from scratch with changing priorities, and happy to be hands-on

  • Exceptional communication in French (fluent) and professional English

  • A member-first mindset: you think about the HP, patient and Alaner experience, not the process

  • Appetite for digital tools, AI and basic automation to reduce repetitive work, and the ability to document in a way the whole team and AI agents can leverage

  • Mobility across Île-de-France (Paris, 77, 92, 95 and more)

  • Visionary and hands-on, autonomous and proactive, at ease with ambiguity while the plan (number of sites, rent vs buy, timing) is still evolving, calm when things don't go as planned, and discreet and respectful of the medical environment

Nice to have

  • Experience of medical, paramedical or health-related sites (centres de santé, clinics, labs), including ERP type U requirements

  • A technical diploma or certification (BTS / DUT in building maintenance or energy, SSIAP) and electrical habilitation

  • Experience of a technical due diligence on a building purchase, or of a sale-and-leaseback / long-lease structure

  • Experience with indoor air quality or energy-efficiency projects

  • Experience using a CMMS / GMAO tool, or building one with no-code tools

  • Extensive experience leveraging AI to build scalable processes or automate recurring tasks

  • Prior experience in a high-growth company or scale-up, ideally in a network-expansion context

 

🙌 Perks & Benefits


At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

 

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.


We'll be thrilled to receive your application!


🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Workplace Experience - Facility Manager in Paris
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Facility Manager — Hard FM

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

 

🎯 What drives us — We're obsessed with helping our members live healthier

  • Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, seeking our mission success above all else.

  • Member & customer-led: obsessively focused on solving members & customers problems and creating the most delightful experiences.

     

🏆 How we build excellence — We hire the best people and give them platform to succeed

  • Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density.

  • Distributed ownership: accountable enlightened despots, everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radically transparent: all information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

     

🤝 How we grow together — We help each other improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

  • Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care and support teammates.

  • Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback combined with praises to help each other grow professionally.

  • Bold & creative contrarians: think differently to achieve greatness, try new approaches.

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

  • Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time.

  • Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality.

     

💡 The Missions

Alan has grown to more than 1,000 Alaners, with 600+ hires expected in 2026 alone.

The Workplace team is the engine behind the experience Alaners have every day, and that experience starts with a building that simply works: safe, comfortable, compliant, with air that is good to breathe and doors that open when they should.

As the company scales, our technical footprint grows with it.

Today, technical maintenance at our Paris HQ (Valmy) relies on a part-time factotum and on team members who handle it on top of some other scopes.

We are opening a dedicated, full-time Facility Manager position to give more love to our offices and to anticipate needs. The first focus is the run at Valmy (our HQ), with a strong prevention mindset.

As Alan keeps growing, more real-estate projects are likely (new floors, a possible office move, sites abroad...): we expect you to grow into the technical lead on them.

The role is part of the Workplace team and covers a single contract: Workplace Experience. The position is based in Paris and requires an onsite presence at least 4 days per week.

👀 The profile we're looking for (level range targeted on our level grid: B1-C1)

Specific missions

  • Make prevention the heart of the role. Identify the main risk areas (HVAC, water leaks, fire safety, access control). Build and run the preventive maintenance calendar, plan the mandatory periodic checks and keep the safety register up to date.

  • Do regular office rounds with the Valmy services team to spot wear and risks (leaks, lighting, HVAC, doors, badge readers, fire safety) before Alaners report them. Turn each finding into an action with an owner and a date.

  • Run day-to-day maintenance. Sort and diagnose Alaners' requests and fix small issues directly yourself (e.g. changing a light bulb). Send the rest to the right contractor, and follow each intervention until the work is done and checked on site.

  • Be the single technical point of contact for our vendors and our landlord. This covers contracts and SLAs (agreed service levels and intervention times), invoice checks, tenders, and escalation of building-level issues under the lease.

  • Own the legal and financial side of FM, with Legal and Finance: regulatory compliance (ERP / labor code safety rules, mandatory checks, audit findings), lease obligations, and the maintenance budget (opex / capex) with monthly cost follow-up and optimization.

  • Keep our offices safe, healthy and comfortable for all Alaners, in line with our Healthy Business positioning (air quality, thermal comfort, fire safety, accessibility...).

  • Track, improve and document. Create and run a simple dashboard (open requests, intervention times, recurring issues, budget), keep the equipment inventory and maintenance log, automate repetitive follow-ups with AI and tools, and write procedures that can be reused for new floors and sites.

  • Own Alan's obligations under the Décret tertiaire (energy-reduction law for office buildings over 1,000 m²) at Valmy and future offices, with the landlords.

  • Cover the technical needs and follow-up required at the Prévenir medical center hosted at Valmy

  • Over time, lead the technical side of our real-estate projects (floor take-overs, office moves, new sites): technical checks of buildings, follow-up of works with architects and project managers, move planning.

  • Work daily with cross-functional teams: Legal (compliance, lease), Finance (budget, invoicing, cost optimization), IT (network, access control, room equipment) and Security (office safety policies, crisis reaction).

  • Join the on-call rotation (daily Office Management tasks).

Key outcomes by 1 year

  • All hard FM contracts are mapped, documented and tracked (scope, SLAs, renewal and exit dates, costs, mandatory checks): no missed regulatory check or expired contract

  • A preventive maintenance plan is live at Valmy, and the share of corrective / emergency interventions has measurably decreased

  • At least 3 prevention areas identified, each with a specific action plan and clear KPIs

  • Regulatory compliance is up to date: safety register complete, periodic checks done on time, audit findings closed

  • New fire safety equipment provider selected and onboarded

  • Air quality measured on all floors, issues diagnosed and a corrective action plan delivered

  • Led at least two vendor reviews or tenders, produced clear findings and took the corresponding decisions autonomously

  • An FM dashboard tracks service quality, vendor performance and budget consumption; at least 3 manual or recurring tasks automated

  • A replicable FM playbook and a building technical checklist exist, ready to be used for a new floor, an office move or a new site

You may be a great fit if you are:

  • A Facility Manager / Technical Manager with 3–6 years of experience on multi-technical (tertiary / office) buildings, in-house at a scale-up or large company

  • Coming from an FM service provider or a property manager (site manager, contract manager) and wanting to move in-house and own the client side

  • A multi-technical maintenance profile (HVAC, electrical, fire safety) who has grown into vendor management, budget ownership and compliance

  • A Workplace manager with an FM scope, or a works / fit-out project manager with solid maintenance and run experience

What we're looking for

  • Solid technical understanding of building systems: HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety systems (alarm, extinguishers, emergency lighting), doors and access control

  • Knowledge of the French regulatory framework for offices (ERP / labor code safety rules, mandatory periodic checks, safety register, safety commission)

  • Proven vendor and contract management: SLAs, penalties, price indexation, tenders, invoice control

  • Ability to manage the landlord relationship and understand lease obligations (who pays and does what)

  • Electrical habilitation (mandatory, as the role fixes small electrical issues directly)

  • Exceptional communication in French (fluent) and professional English

  • Attention to detail, strong problem-solving, and the ability to juggle priorities, including urgent incidents, with a calm and constructive attitude when things go wrong (leak, outage, alarm)

  • A prevention mindset, autonomy and strong accountability: you spot what can be improved before being asked

  • A member-first mindset: you think about the Alaner experience, not the process

  • Appetite for digital tools, AI and basic automation to reduce repetitive work (ticketing, maintenance tracking, dashboards), and the ability to document in a way the whole team and AI agents can leverage

Nice to have

  • A technical diploma or certification (e.g. BTS / DUT in building maintenance or energy, SSIAP)

  • Experience with indoor air quality or energy efficiency projects (sensors, ventilation, Décret tertiaire)

  • Experience with a CMMS / GMAO tool, or building one with no-code tools

  • Experience leveraging AI to build scalable processes or automate recurring tasks

  • Experience in a high-growth tech company or scale-up

  • Having followed or led a fit-out, an office move or a new-site opening

 

🙌 Perks & Benefits


At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

 

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.


We'll be thrilled to receive your application!


🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

raw.title: Senior Project Manager
raw.description:
About Sidetrade

Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. 

Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion: Aimie Video

The role

As a Senior Project Manager, you run enterprise Order-to-Cash implementations from contract signature to go-live and into run. You own the plan, the coordination and the project governance. You deliver on time, on budget, and with a customer who is ready to use what we built.

You join a Customer Experience team that holds its accounts from signature into renewal, alongside a Functional Expert, a Data Engineer and a Customer Success Manager. The customer keeps the same team throughout. You also arrive as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.

Requirements

What you will do:

  • Run the project from kickoff to hypercare: plan, governance, weekly status calls and steering committees with finance leadership up to CFO.
  • Deliver workshops on data mapping, integration and process design, train the customer to run UAT, and coordinate cutover, go-live strategy and business hypercare.
  • Deliver against the baseline date agreed with the customer and the SOW budget, and keep the burn visible.
  • Keep the commercial hygiene tight: billing milestones raised on time, change requests spotted and priced, effort tracked against the SOW.
  • Coordinate the customer's finance, IT and ERP teams with our Functional Experts and Data Engineers through integration, testing and go-live.
  • Lead complex programs, including multi-entity and phased rollouts, with several projects running in parallel at different phases.
  • Raise risks early and bring a plan with them. Take the hard conversation on a slipped date or a scope dispute.
  • Hand over to the Customer Success Manager at the transition into run, with the context Support needs.
  • Keep phase, risk and milestones accurate in Salesforce and our project tools.
  • Work with the AI agents that speed up our implementations, and check what they produce.

What you will bring:

  • 6+ years managing B2B SaaS, ERP or finance-system implementations, with enterprise projects that went live and stayed live.
  • A strong command of project economics: SOW, budget, burn, change requests, billing milestones.
  • Comfort in front of finance leadership, up to CFO, with good news and bad.
  • Order-to-Cash, credit, collections or accounts receivable knowledge, or the proven ability to pick it up fast.
  • The ability to hold several projects at different stages at once without dropping any of them.
  • The candor to say the uncomfortable thing early, to the customer and to Sidetrade.
  • Fluent English and French. German or Spanish is an advantage.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field.

Why Sidetrade

  • AI-native. We are not a software vendor bolting AI onto a legacy product. Aimie IQ and our AI agents are built on the largest proprietary Order-to-Cash Data Lake.
  • Measurable impact. You work with enterprise finance teams on problems tied directly to cash and working capital.
  • Build the method. You join as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.

Benefits

  • Hybrid work model – a flexible mix of in-office and remote days
  • Great culture – active Social Club organizing regular team events and activities
  • Health & wellness – medical coverage, life insurance, and other wellness programs
  • Time off – competitive paid holidays plus public holidays
  • Career growth & compensation – competitive salary, equal opportunities, Edenred card, learning & mentorship programs, and advancement support

Because when you thrive, we all succeed! 

We’re committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive experience for every candidate.

If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, just let us know. 

Agencies 

We only accept applications from invited agencies via our Workable portal. Unsolicited CVs sent to managers or HR won’t be subject to fees.
